# 3 Axial Skyrmions:
- The definition of axial Skyrmions in this paper changes the sign of only one of the pion fields, leading to a different relative phase compared to references [3, 12, 7].
- Contrary to other definitions where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by changing the sign of all three pion fields, the definition in this paper allows for a more natural comparison with monopoles.
- The profile function for Skyrmions and antiSkyrmions is zero at a radius s/2 from the center, allowing for a continuous patching together of the two entities with the fields set to vacuum outside each of the cores.
- Along with initial conditions using the simple ansatz, more sophisticated initial conditions were also employed based on the rational map ansatz with an axially symmetric charge n map.
